title: God's Love And Power
firstLine: When I survey the world in all its splendor,

lines: When I survey the world in all its splendor,
The heavens declare a beautiful array.
Yes, we believe our God still rules in heaven;
The darkest night He changes back to day.
Creation speaks of God in all his glory:
The meadows, lakes and glowers of early spring.
Thru life God shows His care for every creature;
Such love and power inspires my heart to sing.
The greatest gift God gave for our salvation;
He loved the world by giving His dear Son,
The sacrifice He gave for us on Calvary,
Brings life and peace, and hope to everyone.
God's love and power are shown in every scene;
Adorning truth on which we can rely,
When time is over all earth will then proclaim
rist, Lord of lords and King most high.
